subject: Data Engineering
title: Elastic Compute Clusters
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Elastic Compute Clusters.

hook.text: At 2 AM, the cluster idles with 50 nodes. At 9 AM, a hundred analysts hit it simultaneously.

buildup.text: Elastic clusters scale up and down based on demand, adding nodes under load and releasing them when idle.

discovery.text: Auto-scaling policies let you set rules: scale up when CPU exceeds 70%, scale down after 10 minutes idle.

twist.text: Scaling up takes minutes. If traffic spikes instantly, there's a lag before new nodes are ready.

climax.text: Elastic compute turns fixed infrastructure costs into variable costs that match actual demand.

punchline.text: Pay for what you use. Scale for what you need.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of elastic compute clusters?
options: Costs scale with actual demand instead of peak capacity
